## Title guideline (delete this section before submitting)

Use the format:

`<verb> <thing> in <scope>`

Examples:

- Fix pagination bug in deals API
- Add retry logic to S3 uploader
- Refactor validation in timeseries service
- Decide auth strategy for v1

Bad titles:

- Bug
- Fix
- Improve stuff
- Question

---

## What

Clear, one-sentence description of the task or problem.

## Why

Why this matters. What breaks, what improves, or what decision is needed.

## Done when

- [ ] Concrete, testable outcome
- [ ] Edge cases handled
- [ ] Reviewed by at least one other team member

## Notes (optional)

Context, links, screenshots, ideas, constraints.
